thread:
Maya: Quick announcement: we're deprecating the top-level `assistant_mode` flag across SDKs and docs in favor of a structured `capabilities` object. This is to support clearer tool-calling, safety scopes, and per-call capability overrides.

Aaron: TL;DR for engineers: old usage `client.generate(..., assistant_mode='chat')` -> new usage `client.generate(..., capabilities={ 'mode': 'chat', 'tools': ['search','kb'], 'safety_scope': 'strict' })`. SDKs will accept `assistant_mode` for a 60-day compat window and log a single deprecation warning per process.

Lina: Docs plan: publish migration guide, side-by-side examples for py/js/go, and a compatibility table mapping common assistant_mode values to recommended capabilities objects. Also a short FAQ: "When should I use capabilities vs tool manifest?" Draft to #docs-review tomorrow.

Rishi: Support note: prepare KB with detection scripts for customers still sending assistant_mode and a quick codemod to replace the flag. We'll offer a 30-day assisted migration window for large enterprise customers.

Maya: Why this change: the flat `assistant_mode` has been limiting as we add tool-level permissions, regional safety policies, and fine-grained billing tags. `capabilities` lets us evolve without breaking the surface.

Aaron: SDK behavior details:
- SDKs will add `capabilities` param (map).
- If both provided, `capabilities` wins.
- We will not change server defaults; servers will map legacy `assistant_mode` when present.
- Minor semver bump planned for py/js/go to signal new API surface.

Lina: Sample migration (py):
```python
# old
resp = client.generate(prompt, assistant_mode='composer')
# new
resp = client.generate(
  prompt,
  capabilities={
    'mode': 'composer',
    'tools': ['docs_search'],
    'safety_scope': 'moderate'
  }
)
```

Rishi: Timeline:
- Day 0: announce + docs draft (this thread).
- Day 5: SDK preview releases exposing `capabilities`.
- Day 20: docs + codemod published; support KB ready.
- Day 60: server-side enforcement begins for hosted endpoints (requests using only `assistant_mode` will get a deprecation header and a guidance link).
- Day 90+: `assistant_mode` accepted only if compatibility flag enabled per-customer.

compliance-bot: Note: We've reviewed the new param surface for data handling. `capabilities.tools` should not contain PII. We'll add a short section to the DPA FAQ and a checklist for enterprise customers.

Maya: Action items: Lina will post the migration doc, Aaron will drop SDK PR links, Rishi please prep the support rotation, and I'll coordinate customer outreach for enterprise accounts.

Aaron: PRs (WIP): https://github.com/redwood-inference/py-sdk/pull/5178, https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/4092. Do not merge until QA signoff.

Lina: I'll drop the draft to #docs in 2 hours and include a simple codemod example.

Maya: Thanks all — react with :white_check_mark: when read or drop questions here.
